formal_statement: ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧ D.size ≤ 25 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun 17 D = (fun x : Fin 17 → Bool => decide (∃ i j : Fin 17, ((i.val + 1 = j.val ∧ i.val ≠ 8) ∨ (i.val = 0 ∧ (j.val = 8 ∨ j.val = 9 ∨ j.val = 16))) ∧ x i = true ∧ x j = true))
plain_statement: Graph on 17 vertices: two cycles of length 9 sharing vertex 0 (0-1-...-8-0 and 0-9-...-16-0), 18 edges, cover number 9. Claim to exhibit: a circuit with AND, OR, NOT gates of fan-in two, every gate counted, at most 25 gates, computing the function true when both ends of some edge are true. The cover circuit has 26. A witness would refute the open row L-meta-113 at its smallest instance not settled by checked rows; the expected answer is that none exists (then refute this row). Checking a witness means all 131072 inputs. Conjecture.
title: SEARCH: a circuit with at most 25 gates for the edge function of two 9-cycles sharing a vertex
